_how_to: Copy this file to inbox/<your-github-name>/<short-title>.json, fill in what you know, and open a pull request. Fields you don't know can stay empty: the curator assigns ids, facets and status.

contributor.credit_as: How you want to be thanked in CONTRIBUTORS.md

license_confirmation: I wrote this or have the right to share it, and I agree to publish it under CC BY 4.0 (text/JSON) and MIT (code).

context.tool_or_bridge: e.g. RevitBridge, pyRevit, Dynamo, MCP server

intent: What you wanted to achieve, in professional terms
use_when: When should another agent use this? One short sentence per situation
not_for: Similar-looking situations where this does not apply
api_terms: Revit API classes or methods involved
improves: If this improves an existing pack, its id (e.g. ARPL-ASM-0004). Otherwise empty.

iterations.instruction: What you asked for or ran (prompt, JSON, script excerpt)
iterations.found_by: How you noticed (looking at the view, a check, a warning)

notes: Anything else. Do not include client names, addresses, model files, passwords or licensed content.
